items.title: 1.7 Dimensions of physical quantities (physical quantities ki dimensions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.7 with Example 1.4 (PDF 15-17).

blocks.text: Har physical quantity ko kuch familiar (jani pehchani) properties (khoobiyon) se describe kiya ja sakta hai, jaise length, mass, time, temperature, electric current waghaira. In napi ja sakne wali properties ko dimensions kehte hain. Dimensions batati hain ke koi quantity fundamental (buniyadi) quantities se kis tarah bani hai (yani us ki qualitative nature: kis qisam ki quantity hai, kitni nahi). Length, depth (gehrai), height, diameter, light year: yeh sab metre mein napi jati hain, is liye in sab ki dimension ek hi hai, length, jise square bracket mein [L] likhte hain. Isi tarah mass, time, electric current aur temperature ki dimensions [M], [T], [A] aur [θ] hain. Yeh paanch dimensions basic is liye chuni gayi hain ke experiments mein inhen napna aasan hai.

Doosri quantities ki dimensions batati hain ke woh basic quantities se kaise juri hain; yeh fundamental dimensions ka combination (milap) hoti hain. Example: speed v metre per second mein napi jati hai, is liye us ki dimensions length [L] divided by time [T] hain:
Acceleration a = Δv / Δt hai, is liye acceleration ki dimensions:
Isi tarah force (F = ma) ki dimensions:

Dimensions ki madad se hum kisi physical equation ki homogeneity (dono taraf ek jaisi dimensions, yani equation ka sahi hona) check kar sakte hain, aur kisi physical quantity ka formula bhi bana (derive kar) sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Thermometer jaisa scale, degrees Celsius mein, upar 7000 se neeche -273 tak; scale uniform (har jagah barabar) nahi. Nishan: Suraj ka bahar wala hissa, filament lamp, tez Bunsen flame, aluminium pighalta hai, mercury ubalta hai, pani ubalta hai (100 C), alcohol ubalta hai, human body (insani jism), barf pighalti hai (0 C), mercury jamta hai, sab se thanda mausam, alcohol jamta hai, hawa liquid banti hai aur absolute zero.
blocks.caption: Some Specific Temperatures (kuch khaas temperatures) (Interesting Information; kitab ke chart ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Is scale ke gaps barabar nahi: 0 °C se 100 °C wala hissa khula hai aur 1000 °C se upar har 1000 °C ka hissa chhota hai, taake −273 °C se Suraj ke bahar wale hisse (taqreeban 6000 °C) tak sab ek hi patti par aa jaye. Is liye sirf likhi values parhein: pani 100 °C par ubalta hai, barf 0 °C par pighalti hai, human body taqreeban 37 °C, aur absolute zero −273 °C hai.

blocks.text: Homogeneity of Physical Equations (physical equations ki homogeneity)

Equation sahi (correct) hai ya nahi, yeh check karne ke liye dekhte hain ke equation ke dono taraf quantities ki dimensions ek jaisi hain ya nahi. Ise principle of homogeneity (dono taraf ek jaisa hone ka rule) kehte hain.
Farz karein ek car rest (ruki hui halat) se chalti hai (vᵢ = 0) aur acceleration a ke saath time t mein distance S tay karti hai. Equation of motion yeh hai:
½ jaise numerical factors (sirf number) ki koi dimension nahi hoti, is liye unhen chhor dete hain. Dono taraf dimensions rakhein:
Dono taraf dimensions ek jaisi hain, is liye equation dimensionally correct (sahi) hai.

blocks.alt: Pendulum oopar ek pivot se latakta hai. Us ke saath juda curved (mura hua) anchor hai jis ke do pallet daanton (teeth) wale escape wheel ke daanton ko pakarte hain; teer dikhata hai ke wheel clockwise ghoomta hai. Labels: anchor, pallet, escape wheel, pendulum (regulating device).
blocks.caption: The device which made the pendulum clock practical (woh device jis ne pendulum clock ko kaam ke qabil banaya) (Do You Know; kitab ki figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Escape wheel ko ghari ka spring ya weight (wazan) ghumata hai. Pendulum har jhool par anchor ko idhar udhar hilata hai; anchor ka ek pallet wheel ka ek daant chhorta hai aur doosra agla daant rok leta hai. Is tarah wheel har jhool par sirf ek daant aage barhta hai, aur pendulum ka barabar time period ghari ki speed ko control (regulate) karta hai.

blocks.text: Derivation of a Formula (formula derive karna, yani nikaalna)
Agar hamein andaza ho ke koi quantity kin factors par depend karti hai, to dimensions ki madad se us ka possible (mumkin) formula banaya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Example 1.4
blocks.problem: Circle (daire) mein uniform (ek jaisi) speed se chalti cheez ke liye centripetal force (markaz ki taraf force) ka formula derive karein. Farz karein centripetal force cheez ke mass m, circle ke radius r aur speed v par depend karti hai.
steps: F ∝ mᵃvᵇrᶜ, yani F = (constant) mᵃvᵇrᶜ ...... (i); a, b, c maloom karne hain.
Constant ki dimension nahi, is liye dimensions mein: [F] = [mᵃ][vᵇ][rᶜ]
Dono taraf powers compare karein (milayein): M ki power: a = 1; L ki power: b + c = 1; T ki power: −b = −2
(i) mein rakhein: F = (constant) m v² r⁻¹ = (constant) mv²/r
Constant ki value dimensions se nahi milti; experiment se yeh 1 nikalti hai.

blocks.title: Beware! (dhyan rakhein!)

blocks.text: Limitations in Dimensional Analysis (dimensional analysis ki hadein)

Dimensional method (tareeqa) yeh nahi bata sakta ke equation mein ghalti kahan hai. Agar equation dimensionally correct nikle, tab bhi hum sirf itna keh sakte hain ke equation sahi ho sakti hai, kyunke yeh method numerical factors ya constants (jaise ½ ya 2π) ko check nahi karta. Yeh sirf experiment se ya variables ka suitable (munasib) graph bana kar maloom hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Check karein ke v² = vᵢ² + 2aS dimensionally correct hai, aur dimensions se dikhayein ke simple pendulum ka time period T = constant × √(ℓ/g) hai.
blocks.explanation: [v²] = [LT⁻¹]² = [L²T⁻²]; [vᵢ²] bhi yahi; [aS] = [LT⁻²][L] = [L²T⁻²]. Har term ki dimension [L²T⁻²] hai, is liye equation homogeneous hai. Pendulum: T = (constant) ℓᵃgᵇ lein: [T] = [L]ᵃ[LT⁻²]ᵇ = [Lᵃ⁺ᵇ T⁻²ᵇ]. To a + b = 0 aur −2b = 1, yani b = −½, a = ½. Is liye T = constant × ℓ¹ᐟ² g⁻¹ᐟ² = constant × √(ℓ/g). Constant (2π) dimensions se nahi milta.
